title: Languages of the World
description: Schema for language frontmatter (one file per ISO 639-3 code).
$comment: Property order below is the canonical emission order. Tools that write these files must preserve it.

iso639_1.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter code, when one exists (e.g. 'aa' for aar). From the SIL ISO 639-3 code table (Part1). Populated by tools/sources/iso639.go.

macrolanguage_id.description: ISO 639-3 code of the macrolanguage this individual language belongs to (e.g. 'zho' for cmn). From the SIL macrolanguage mappings. Populated by tools/sources/iso639.go.

name.description: Common English name of the language.

autonym.description: Endonym (the language's name written in the language itself).

alt_names.description: Deduplicated array of alternative names for this language, drawn from Glottolog's names.csv (multi-provider) and SIL's ISO 639-3 Name Index. Excludes the canonical `name` and `autonym`.

location.description: Free-text location where the language is spoken — country/region names, sometimes with a map reference (e.g. 'Nigeria, Map 6'). Migrated from DBS language records.

area.description: One-line characterization of the language and where it is spoken (e.g. 'Edoid language spoken in Nigeria'). Migrated from DBS language records.

status_id.description: EGIDS vitality (Expanded Graded Intergenerational Disruption Scale).

scope.description: ISO 639-3 code scope. Populated by tools/sources/iso639.go.

language_type.description: ISO 639-3 language type. Populated by tools/sources/iso639.go.

iso_lwc.description: ISO 639-3 code of the practical language of wider communication (LWC / lingua franca) a speaker of this language is most likely to fall back to, derived from the language's territory. Self-referential when the language is itself the territory's LWC (e.g. eng → eng). Not an official ISO relationship; a sociolinguistic default only. Populated by tools/sources/iso_lwc.go; set for living languages only.

language_map_img.description: Filename of a language-area map image (e.g. 'deu.webp', 'Map-Francophone_World.svg'), served from https://img.dbs.org/country/languages/{filename}. Migrated from DBS language records.

scripts.description: ISO 15924 codes for the writing systems this language uses (primary + secondary). Populated by tools/sources/cldr.go. Cross-references the sibling `scripts/` repo.

glottocode.description: Glottolog languoid ID, e.g. 'aari1239'. Populated by tools/sources/glottolog.go.

glottolog_family_id.description: Glottolog ID of the top-level family this language belongs to.

glottolog_family_name.description: Human-readable name of the Glottolog family.

glottolog_classification.description: Top-down genealogical path from family to leaf, joined with ' > '.

wikidata_id.description: Wikidata entity ID (QID, e.g. 'Q27811'), resolved via the P220 (ISO 639-3 code) claim. Populated by tools/sources/wikidata_id.go.

wikipedia_url.description: English Wikipedia article URL. Populated by tools/sources/wikipedia.go via Wikidata P220.

translations.description: Translations of the language name into other languages. Each item: {translation_iso (ISO 639-3 of the target), name, auto?}. Curated by tools/sources/wikidata_names.go and tools/sources/cldr_names.go. Future LLM/MT entries set `auto: true`.

rolv_dialects.description: GRN Registry of Language Varieties (ROLV) entries that fall under this ISO 639-3 code. Populated by tools/sources/rolv.go.

translation_iso.description: ISO 639-3 code of the target language.

auto.description: True when produced by automated (LLM/MT) translation rather than a curated upstream.

language_tag.description: BCP-47 language tag; most rows are `<iso>-x-HIS#####` but a small minority use plain BCP-47 (e.g. `en-US`, `zh-Hans-x-HIS04837`).

name.description: Variety name as published by GRN.

country_id.description: Primary country of the variety (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

location.description: Free-text location, often country with sub-region.
